plan.line: an active buzzer module: beeps at one fixed pitch (about 2300 Hz) while switched on; simple on/off code, no notes or melodies. Use it only when the idea names an active buzzer; for tones, melodies or a plain "buzzer" use the passive buzzer.

code.pinLine: active buzzer {ref} on {gpio}, which beeps while the pin is LOW: buzzer = Pin({g}, Pin.OUT, value=1) so it starts quiet; buzzer.value(0) beeps, buzzer.value(1) stops. End the program with the pin HIGH. It has one fixed pitch: don't use PWM or notes.
